facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's national digital health strategy states that the health information system (DHIS2) has been deployed in all of the country's health districts; it does not say where below the district data are entered, and gives no date, so the strategy's year is used.

The Stratégie Nationale Santé Numérique 2021-2025 names project P221, an SNIS data warehouse and extension of DHIS2, among 19 projects in an action plan costed at USD 12 million (GNF 120,000 million) over five years, with most funds programmed for 2022 and 2023.

The 2021-2025 strategy assigns technical coordination of its implementation, including the SNIS and DHIS2 project, to the SMSI/BSD of the Ministry of Health under a steering committee; the strategy itself was drawn up with WHO and GIZ financial and technical support and EU co-financing, and lists lack of financing as a main risk.
